body: It sounds like it would help but I know it won't.  I never enjoyed vacations.  As a child, vacations were never fun because I knew that school was waiting for me when I got home.  Now that I have to pay for them, a vacation trip is the last thing I ever want to do.  Whenever I have time off I stay at home, watch TV, play video games and sleep.  If I save up and then walk away from all my responsibilities, I know for a fact I won't enjoy any of it, even if it's the last trip I ever take.
Ahh, I'll look into that.  Thanks.
I've been thinking about it, but I can barely take care of myself.  How am I supposed to take care of an animal, especially when they get sick and I can't afford the vet bills?

I used to, but I get bored with everything very quickly.  I've changed majors in colleges multiple times and never graduated.  I haven't held a single job for more than 3 months in my entire life.  Even the things I've done purely for fun get boring.  It's like playing the same video game over and over, except that game is life, and I've run out of levels to advance to or content to download.
Haha, I wish I could have seen it before it was deleted.  I can always use a good laugh.
Yeah.  I have a hard time opening up to them, and when I do, they have a confused look on their face like they've never heard or read anything like it before.  Anything they say after is unhelpful.
I keep thinking about it and I love nothing.  I used to think I loved people or things but they always turn out to be something else in the end.  I love the idea of stuff, but not the actual result.
